patterns.description: curl or wget output piped into a shell
patterns.fix: Download the file, review it, and pin it to a checksum or version before running it; do not pipe remote content into an interpreter.
patterns.why: Code fetched and executed at run time can change after review, so the reviewed skill no longer describes what actually runs.

patterns.description: curl uploading data to a non-local host
patterns.fix: Remove the outbound transfer, or limit it to a documented host the user has approved and say so in SKILL.md.
patterns.why: Sending local data to an external host is the standard way a malicious skill leaks files, credentials or conversation content.
